description: This file defines the HttpUtil class with static methods for HTTP header parsing, URL handling, and header validation, used within the Chromium project. It includes functions for parsing headers, validating header names/values, handling language lists, and iterating over HTTP headers.

classes.name: HttpUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for HTTP header parsing, URL processing, and validation tasks.

classes.name: HeadersIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing HTTP headers in raw string format.

classes.name: ValuesIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for iterating over delimited header values, handling HTTP quoted strings.

classes.name: NameValuePairsIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for parsing name-value pairs in HTTP headers, supporting optional values and strict quoting.

methods.name: SpecForRequest
methods.description: Returns the absolute URL for an HTTP request, stripping username, password, and reference.

methods.name: ParseContentType
methods.description: Parses the Content-Type header into mime type, charset, and boundary.

methods.name: ParseRangeHeader
methods.description: Parses the Range header as per RFC 7233.

methods.name: ParseContentRangeHeaderFor206
methods.description: Extracts byte range and length info from Content-Range header for 206 responses.

methods.name: ParseRetryAfterHeader
methods.description: Parses Retry-After header into a time delta.

methods.name: IsMethodSafe
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP method is safe.

methods.name: IsMethodIdempotent
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP method is idempotent.

methods.name: IsSafeHeader
methods.description: Determines if a header with given name and value is safe.

methods.name: IsValidHeaderName
methods.description: Validates an HTTP header name.

methods.name: IsValidHeaderValue
methods.description: Validates an HTTP header value.

methods.name: IsNonCoalescingHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header cannot be coalesced into a comma-separated list.

methods.name: IsLWS
methods.description: Checks if a character is linear white space (SP or HT).

methods.name: TrimLWS
methods.description: Trims LWS characters from beginning and end of a string.

methods.name: IsTokenChar
methods.description: Checks if a character is a valid token character as per RFC 7230.

methods.name: IsToken
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid token.

methods.name: IsControlChar
methods.description: Checks if a character is a control character.

methods.name: IsParmName
methods.description: Validates parameter name as per RFC 5987.

methods.name: Unquote
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes and unescapes quoted-pairs in a string.

methods.name: StrictUnquote
methods.description: Unquotes and validates quoted strings, returning false on errors.

methods.name: Quote
methods.description: Escapes and surrounds a string with quotes.

methods.name: LocateStartOfStatusLine
methods.description: Finds the start index of the status line in a buffer.

methods.name: LocateEndOfHeaders
methods.description: Finds the end index of HTTP headers in a buffer.

methods.name: LocateEndOfAdditionalHeaders
methods.description: Finds the end index of additional headers or trailers.

methods.name: AssembleRawHeaders
methods.description: Converts raw header buffer into normalized header string.

methods.name: ConvertHeadersBackToHTTPResponse
methods.description: Converts raw headers back to HTTP response format.

methods.name: ExpandLanguageList
methods.description: Expands language list by adding base languages.

methods.name: GenerateAcceptLanguageHeader
methods.description: Generates Accept-Language header with q-values.

methods.name: HasStrongValidators
methods.description: Checks if response has strong validators (ETag or Last-Modified).

methods.name: HasValidators
methods.description: Checks if response has any validators.

methods.name: GetStatusCodesForHistogram
methods.description: Returns common HTTP status codes for histogram purposes.

methods.name: MapStatusCodeForHistogram
methods.description: Maps a status code to histogram bucket.

methods.name: ParseAcceptEncoding
methods.description: Parses Accept-Encoding header into allowed encodings.

methods.name: ParseContentEncoding
methods.description: Parses Content-Encoding header into used encodings.

methods.name: HeadersContainMultipleCopiesOfField
methods.description: Checks if headers contain multiple copies of a field.
